entries.title: Remove CI source self-modification
acceptance: validation workflows use contents: read
no workflow commits, pushes, tags, merges or runs clippy --fix on candidate source
machine check rejects write-enabled validation workflows

entries.title: Enforce strict canonical JSON across World transition implementations
acceptance: invalid JSON syntax fails
duplicate and decoded-unsorted object keys fail
signed-i64-only numbers are enforced
leading zero, negative zero, floats, exponents, NaN and overflow fail
nonminimal escapes and trailing bytes fail
depth above 128 fails
decoded authority keys fail recursively
Rust and independent conformance implementation reproduce all positive and negative vectors

entries.title: Integrate the deterministic World transition contract
acceptance: contract package, schema, vectors, negative vectors, docs and workflow are in one review stack
contract has no external I/O or authority credential surface
stable error codes and resource budgets are published
exact-head CI is green

entries.title: Bound settlement worker shutdown
acceptance: SIGINT and SIGTERM stop new capture and claim promptly
in-flight jobs drain within configured grace
grace expiry cancels local work and leaves lease-recoverable durable state
shutdown behavior is covered by source and runtime tests

entries.title: Quarantine poison settlement work and preserve unrelated progress
acceptance: one invalid match does not stop capture of unrelated matches
one invalid claimed row does not stop unrelated claims
one invalid capture does not stop unrelated apply
quarantine has bounded reason, digest, attempts, retry time and operator-visible projection
duplicate campaign job per capture is impossible at database level

entries.title: Converge malformed success, response loss and conflict
acceptance: 2xx malformed signer response is ambiguous and retried through lookup
2xx malformed CEX response is ambiguous and retried through lookup
409/duplicate race performs exact lookup before terminal classification
bounded error body is recorded
same remote request identity produces at most one durable value effect

entries.title: Durable capture-execute-apply settlement
acceptance: capture commits before remote attempt
live lease fences every remote mutation
lookup precedes submit
remote success and campaign apply are separate
exact campaign and terminal fences are revalidated
operator replay is append-only and exact identity bound
Rust and PostgreSQL exact-head checks pass
deployed fault matrix passes
independent review is recorded

entries.title: Protect main and require current checks
acceptance: main ruleset observed through GitHub API
direct and force push blocked
pull request and code-owner review required
stale review dismissed and conversations resolved
exact current checks required
administrator bypass is absent or explicit break-glass audited

entries.title: Implement Nakama adapter and shadow comparison
acceptance: Nakama consumes exact contract revision
accepted and rejected bytes/hashes match
zero unexplained divergence across corpus and load
Nakama owns admission, order, idempotency and restart recovery
World never receives Nakama private key

entries.title: Bind cutover, drain, rollback and exact component lock
acceptance: exact World, Nakama, CEX and Integration revisions are locked
new admission is Nakama-only
World-local active matches are drained or takeover is independently proven
rollback and authority disablement rehearsal pass
Nakama is sole MatchCompletedV1 signer

entries.title: Decompose correctness-critical modules
acceptance: HTTP, identity, authority, persistence, journal, settlement, readiness, fleet and operations boundaries are explicit
generated source does not hide semantic changes
lock order and durable/public boundary are documented
module invariant tests pass

entries.title: Publish HTTP, WebSocket and error contracts
acceptance: OpenAPI and message schemas validate implementation examples
stable errors include retry semantics
compatibility and retirement dates are explicit
unknown field and enum behavior is specified

entries.title: Specify PostgreSQL API, privileges and lock order
acceptance: every stored procedure has preconditions, postconditions, result codes and retry behavior
role privileges and supported PostgreSQL versions are explicit
global lock graph matches implementation
migration, rollback, PITR and old-primary matrix passes

entries.title: Portable clean-host installation
acceptance: clean host needs no sibling checkout
production requires verified selector
install, upgrade, rollback and uninstall pass
personal paths are absent

entries.title: Credential isolation and custody migration
acceptance: role-specific issuance, TTL, rotation and revocation pass
moderator compromise cannot sign or settle
game authority compromise cannot export signer key
KMS/HSM and mTLS/workload identity evidence is approved

entries.title: Reproducible signed release
acceptance: toolchain and action revisions pinned
SBOM and licence inventory attached
provenance and release signatures verify
rebuild digest comparison is recorded

entries.title: Complete authority and settlement fault matrices
acceptance: all command, signer, CEX, process, database, journal and cutover crash points converge
raw evidence binds exact components and environment
limitations and expiry are recorded

entries.title: Complete isolated clean 24-hour endurance
acceptance: 24-hour run finishes with final summary
resource domain is isolated
binary, topology, thresholds and raw artifacts are bound
no partial credit is used

entries.title: Complete human single-player and multiplayer validation

non-developer unguided vertical slice passes
accessibility/input matrix passes
multiplayer comprehension and recovery pass
consent, privacy, exact build and reviewer decision are bound

dispute, refund, chargeback and support operations pass
